quote: There are youngsters like cockroaches, who don't get any employment or have any place in the profession. Some of them become media, some of them become social media, RTI activists and other activists, and they start attacking everyone.
author: CJI Surya Kant
context: Said during an open court hearing, comparing unemployed youth and activists to 'parasites' and 'cockroaches' for questioning the judiciary.

quote: The allegations levelled against the accused... hardly constitute an offence of attempt to rape. In order to bring out a charge of attempt to rape, the prosecution must establish that it had gone beyond the stage of preparation.
author: Justice Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra
context: Ruled that grabbing a minor girl's breasts, loosening her garment, and trying to drag her under a culvert did not amount to 'attempt to rape' — merely 'preparation.'

quote: If you want to marry her we can help you. If not, you lose your job and go to jail.
author: CJI SA Bobde
context: Asked a 23-year-old man accused of raping a 16-year-old girl — a distant relative — whether he would marry her, offering to 'help' facilitate it.
